entry.title: Timex Atelier NBR Synthetic Rubber Strap: Signature By Design. Now Available Separately.
entry.content:
Timex Atelier is defined by thoughtful design, where every element has a purpose and every detail contributes to the whole. Now, that same approach extends to a standalone NBR synthetic rubber strap, specially crafted to complement the Timex Atelier Marine M1a and GMT24 M1a.

 

Designed exclusively for these two M1a styles, the strap is precisely shaped to meet the case, creating a seamless transition from watch to wrist. Its profile tapers from 20mm to 18mm, lending the watch a refined, considered silhouette.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

MATERIAL, CONSIDERED

Chosen for its balance of durability, flexibility, and lightweight comfort, NBR (Nitrile Butadiene Rubber) synthetic rubber makes the strap as functional as it is refined. Its supple construction sits comfortably on the wrist, while a subtle textured matte black finish adds understated character without distracting from the watch itself.

 

SECURE BY DESIGN

A stainless-steel deployant clasp provides a secure, comfortable fit and opens and closes with ease. By reducing the bending and creasing that comes with repeated fastening, the deployant construction also helps preserve the strap's shape and finish over time.

 

Discreet Timex Atelier branding appears on both the clasp and inside the strap, keeping the finishing details considered and restrained. 

CHANGE IT IN SECONDS

Versatility should feel effortless. Integrated quick-release spring bars allow the strap to be changed in seconds, without tools.

 

The result is a simple way to give the Marine M1a or GMT24 M1a a different expression on the wrist, while maintaining the precise proportions and considered character of Timex Atelier.

 

One watch. Another way to make it yours.

entry.title: Cavatina Luxe: The Name Says It All
entry.content:
A New Take On Cavatina

Small watches have a way of making a statement without trying too hard. The latest additions to our Cavatina lineup embrace that idea with a slightly larger 22mm curved case, understated dial details, and a range of finishes and attachments that offers so many ways to style this retro mini.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

PERFECTLY PETITE

At 22mm, the new Cavatina brings a little more presence to its signature petite profile. Its polished stainless-steel case follows a smooth, curved silhouette, complemented by a delicately domed mineral glass crystal.

 

The dial keeps things just as considered. Rather than filling the face with detail, two simple metallic hour markers at 12 and 6 o’clock give the design a clean, understated finish.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

THREE DIALS, THREE DISTINCT LOOKS

Cavatina’s minimal design leaves room for its dial to do the talking. Glossy black enamel keeps things sleek and simple. Natural mother-of-pearl introduces an iridescent shine, with variations in color and luster that make each dial unique. And natural malachite brings rich, earthy color to the wrist, with distinctive striations that give every watch its own character.

 

Different by nature, each dial offers a new way to wear the same timeless shape.

 

MADE TO WEAR YOUR WAY

The choice continues beyond the dial.

 

Select styles feature a tarnish-free stainless-steel bracelet with curved links and a self-adjustable design that can be easily sized without tools. For a softer finish, our Cavatina is also available with a supple natural leather strap sourced from the Leather Working Group (LWG), promoting sustainable leather production.

 

Both options complement the watch’s petite proportions while giving it a distinct personality on the wrist.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_3]

TINY PROFILE. LASTING IMPACT.

With its curved 22mm case, domed crystal, minimal markers, and carefully considered dial and attachment options, the newest Cavatina proves that a watch doesn’t need to be oversized to get noticed.

 

Understated, elegant, and easy to make your own, it’s a small watch with plenty of ways to wear it.
